name: Bulk Update M3U8 Domain

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      old_domain:
        description: 'Domain lama yang ingin diganti (contoh: pulvexa.space)'
        required: true
        default: 'pulvexa.space'
      new_domain:
        description: 'Domain baru pengganti (contoh: pulvexa.online)'
        required: true

jobs:
  replace-domain:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Bulk Replace Domain in Files
        run: |
          OLD_DOM="${{ github.event.inputs.old_domain }}"
          NEW_DOM="${{ github.event.inputs.new_domain }}"

          echo "Mengganti '$OLD_DOM' menjadi '$NEW_DOM' pada seluruh file proyek..."

          # Mencari dan mengganti string domain di file .m3u, .m3u8, .js, .json, dan .env
          find . -type f \( -name "*.m3u" -o -name "*.m3u8" -o -name "*.js" -o -name "*.json" -o -name "*.env" \) \
            -not -path '*/.*' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' \
            -exec sed -i "s|${OLD_DOM}|${NEW_DOM}|g" {} +

      - name: Commit & Push Changes
        run: |
          git config --global user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config --global user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

          if [[ -n $(git status --porcelain) ]]; then
            git add .
            git commit -m "chore: bulk update domain from '${{ github.event.inputs.old_domain }}' to '${{ github.event.inputs.new_domain }}'"
            git push
            echo "✅ Domain berhasil diperbarui secara massal!"
          else
            echo "ℹ️ Tidak ada file yang berubah."
          fi
